newsitem.title: USA: Toray drops price of drives by $100.
newsitem.headline: Toray drops price of drives by $100.

text.p: Toray Optical Storage Solutions, a division of Toray Industries Inc's Toray Marketing & Sales (America) Inc affiliate, said Monday it reduced the price on its Phasewriter Dual PD drives by $100, adding they will now sell at $299 and $399.
Toray said in a release that effective street prices will be about $299 and $399 for Toray's PD internal and external drives, respectively.

Toray said the "new price reduction enhances the value of PD drives to potential customers who may not have previously recognized long-term savings that PD provides as a multi-function backup storage device and CD-player."
Toray said "greater acceptance of PD technology and effective higher production levels have significantly driven prices down."
